payload.entry: ROOT-CAUSE EVIDENCE (from sase-ws land agent, 2026-09-06): see the parallel note on sase-x1 — a sibling models-panel node in tests/test_models_panel_layout.py failed under the check-full xdist lane with OptionDoesNotExist and was root-caused: alias rows are applied only after the on_mount provider-snapshot thread worker finishes (_views starts empty at models_panel.py:207), so reading/highlighting alias rows after a single 'await pilot.pause()' races under load. tests/test_models_panel_edit_reset.py mounts and drives alias rows the same way (0 wait_for_snapshot_idle calls in the file), so this node plausibly shares that mechanism rather than a process-global state leak. Deterministic guard: 'await wait_for_snapshot_idle(pilot, panel)' from tests/_models_panel_helpers.py after mount, as now used in tests/test_models_panel_layout.py (fixed as sase-ws landing work).
